author: r1-iter-b
rationale: Encoder aligns the line (first ink row -> vertical crop via a one-hot shift basis; first ink column -> horizontal alignment), cuts 8 fixed-pitch 12px cells, scores each with 10 hand-drawn 15x12 glyph templates plus a presence row, picks the left-bearing offset (0..3) that best explains cell 0, and writes a 12x13 logit table (EOS where a cell has no ink). The step bundle selects row `step` of the table.
